verdict.rationale: Telemetry and usage-tracking controls are a fair privacy question for a speech-to-text API and open-source library, so the axis applies. The evidence pack covers only transcription features, model sizes, CLI and Python usage, and performance. It contains no documentation of a telemetry or usage-tracking opt-out for either the hosted API or the local package. Local installation and execution is an adjacent capability, not a documented opt-out, so it earns no credit.
